items.prose: [VANCE]: 'The audit shows twenty-four hundred rounds missing from Box 12, Kline. I cannot stamp your muster slip without the brass chits.' / [KLINE]: 'The perimeter snipers didn't fire blanks at the ghouls in Sector 3, Vance. You want brass chits? Go out into the ash with a broom and pick them up.'

[SCAR]: 'Wait until the water tanker hits the culvert bend. The ice is thin over the creek; when the front axle drops through, hit the driver with the grease gun. Take the filter pump intact. If you puncture the tank, I'll hang you from the signal gantry.'

[MIRA]: 'The root-rot is inside the recirculating nutrient loops, Director. We lost seventy percent of the Tier 2 seed potatoes in forty-eight hours.' / [HOLT]: 'Not a single word of this outside this room, Mira. If the dormitories hear about this, they will storm the flour silos before midnight.'

[LUKAS]: 'The 18 Hz P-wave harmonic is building along the South Ridge fault. In forty-eight hours, the old highway tunnel will collapse under forty meters of shale.' / [TRADER]: 'Here is your box of morphine ampoules, Brother. The caravan will take the valley pass instead. The earth speaks, and we profit.'

[ELI]: 'The Office machine shop has twelve tungsten-carbide lathe cutting bits locked in the master tool cabinet. When the night watch switches posts at 03:00, we slip the latch with a tempered hacksaw blade. The Synod crucible needs hard metal, not bureaucratic dust.'

[ROSS]: 'The Eastern Pass is gone, Tanya. The mudslide brought down two thousand tons of irradiated shale across Mile 14.' / [TANYA]: 'I have seventeen sealed letters for Bunker 08, Ross. If the pass is blocked, I'll climb the railway trestle on foot. People paid three months of salt chits for these words.'

[SILAS]: 'Tell the refugees in Sector 5 that the well in the north dried up. Double the price of distilled water to eight scrip per liter. By Friday, they'll trade their wedding rings and gold teeth for a single gallon of clean runoff.'
